am-hero.title: A small village on a cliff overlooking the ocean
am-hero.caption: A breathtaking view of a charming coastal town perched on the cliffs of the Amalfi Coast in Italy. The town is a picturesque collection of colorful buildings, stacked on top of one another as they rise from the water's edge to the green, terraced hillsides above. Majestic mountains in the background are partially shrouded in mist, adding depth and drama to the scene. Below, boats are docked in the calm waters of the Mediterranean, further highlighting the beauty and serenity of this iconic destination.
am-hero.description: A small village on a cliff overlooking the ocean
am-hero.author: Alexander Voronov
